kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتمرمغ (form IIq)
# نَتَمَرْمَغُ (natamarmaḡu) /na.ta.mar.ma.ɣu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَرْمَغَ (tamarmaḡa)
# نَتَمَرْمَغَ (natamarmaḡa) /na.ta.mar.ma.ɣa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَرْمَغَ (tamarmaḡa)
# نَتَمَرْمَغْ (natamarmaḡ) /na.ta.mar.maɣ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَرْمَغَ (tamarmaḡa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
